ops.title: Fleet naming rule: product name on every user-visible surface
ops.body: Faceless helper apps are fine, but every user-visible surface (app name, icon, cask token, notification identity) carries the product name, never an internal slug. captain-hook's helper cask token is 'captain-hook' (renamed from 'capt-hook-helper' in 045650d6, before the first cask release); bundle IDs (com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper*), the app group (SXKCTF23Q2.com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper), and portal profile names ('Captain Hook Helper App'/'Captain Hook Helper Widget') are internal identifiers and stay. Precedent: cc-pool's app cask is 'cc-pool-status'. The token 'capt-hook' stays reserved for a future CLI formula.
